title: Time-box a Flaky Operation
prompt:
Wrap an arbitrary task with a timeout: return its result if it finishes in time, otherwise throw TimeoutException. Use Task.WhenAny + Task.Delay (or Task.WaitAsync — .NET 8+).

```csharp
static Task<string> WithTimeout(Task<string> work, int timeoutMs);
```

tests.name: fast path wins
tests.hint: Task.WhenAny(work, Task.Delay(timeoutMs)); if winner != work throw TimeoutException, else await work.

tests.name: slow path times out
tests.hint: Task.Delay(50) beats the 2s work — WhenAny returns the delay; throw TimeoutException.
